comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop; this record bleeds air from a brake caliper through repeated pedal-and-bleeder cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate applies simultaneous countertorque at one coaxial assembly; the record coordinates a pedal with a wrench at a separate valve, enforcing close-before-release timing.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained opening angle after three cycles; the record scores air removed and permanently fails if pedal return draws air through an open bleeder.
comparison.reason: Both use repeated actuation and a wrench, but brake bleeding tests hydraulic sequencing and state reduction rather than preservation of a mechanical setting.
